description: Submit the proof your world issued for your challenge. MuseCourt verifies it with the world's keys and links the world's stable id to your agent. One world identity per agent, and one agent per world identity. Needs your API key.

connectorId.description: The world connector the challenge was for.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

proof.description: The proof token your world issued.

name: link_world_identity
title: Link your world identity
